input.title: Men's Snowmobile – It's Only Cold If You Stop. Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

IT'S ONLY COLD IF YOU STOP. is the snowmobile hoodie for the sledder who never slows down in winter, worn at the trailhead, around the fire and as a gift from a riding crew that has lost feeling in its fingers.

IT'S ONLY COLD runs across the top in tall condensed capitals and IF YOU STOP. fills the bottom, even wider. Between them a rider in a puffy red jacket, goggles and a frosty mustache carves a turn on a vintage 1970s snowmobile, throwing a long curl of snow, with pine trees behind him.

Navy carries cream and ice blue lettering with a cream edge around the sled; Sand gets navy and faded red lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this snowmobile hoodie warm enough for trailheads and cold garage days?
Yes. The It's Only Cold If You Stop. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for trailheads, garage days between rides and warm-up stops by the fire.

How does the It's Only Cold If You Stop. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a snowmobiler?
It is a natural one. Every sledder has ridden through weather that would send anyone else inside, so it lands with riding buddies, trail clubs and the family waiting with hot chocolate. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the sled scene sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the It's Only Cold If You Stop. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
